profile.name: Nova Tutors
profile.description: Small independent tutoring company offering personalised one-to-one GCSE tutoring.
profile.location: London, plus online across the UK
profile.services: GCSE Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Combined Science
profile.unsupported: English, History, Geography, Languages, Computer Science, A-Level, university, primary school, SATs
profile.pricing: £30 per hour (60 min sessions). Free 15-minute initial consultation.
profile.ideal_customer: Parents or guardians of Year 10 and 11 students who want extra GCSE Maths or Science support.
profile.qualification: Student year, subject, current grade, target grade, areas of weakness, exam board, online or in-person, location, availability.
profile.guardrails: Never guarantee grades. Never invent prices, availability or services. Never offer unauthorised discounts. Never confirm a booking that has not happened.
profile.approval: Human approval for first outreach, discounts, complaints, policy exceptions and anything outside known information.
profile.faqs: Sessions are 60 minutes. Online tutoring is available across the UK.
profile.availability: Mon-Fri 4-8pm, Sat 10am-5pm, Sun 10am-4pm. Exact tutor availability varies.
